verdict.rationale: Avalara's evidence describes tax logic that runs automatically inside checkout, invoicing, ERP and order-processing flows once integrated via the API. It also notes that return filing can be embedded into partner workflows and mentions an 'Avi Agent', which is the closest it gets to background automation. Nothing shows users configuring their own autonomous automations or agent jobs that run unattended in the background. missing for 10: user-configurable scheduled or event-triggered automations, any documentation of what the Avi Agent does or whether it acts autonomously, background job monitoring and controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
